scheme_name: Persons With Disabilities Scheme In Colleges: Higher Education For Persons With Special Needs
other_conditions: College must be approved by the UGC under Sections 2(f) and 12B.
College must have enrolled disabled persons (e.g., visual impairment, hearing impairment, locomotor disability) in its courses.
College must constitute an expert committee including faculty members, field experts, and differently‑abled persons, which must meet at least once a year.
Disability definitions must be in accordance with the Persons with Disabilities Act 1995.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for establishing enabling units, improving campus accessibility, and procuring special equipment to enhance the learning experiences of differently‑abled students in higher education institutions.
